summary.text: Richard Bailey is a Republican state representative from Lamoille-2 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Richard Bailey was born in Morristown, Vermont, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northeastern University.
His career experience includes working in the energy industry.
Bailey assumed office in the Vermont House on January 8, 2025.
